name: Future Forward PAC
summary: The main pro-Harris super PAC in 2024 and Democrats' largest outside spender in presidential races, known for testing ads at scale. With its nonprofit arm Future Forward USA Action, which does not disclose donors, it had raised about $700 million by mid-October 2024, and it supplied most of the outside money backing Harris. Dustin Moskovitz was its top disclosed individual donor.
